featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Convoy
featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**. 
   
   ![Convoy Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/40c74b71-7a64-47ba-9bc4-a65bdfab5293.avif)

featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

today.name: OFFICIAL LTR PINKTOBER CONVOY!
today.description:
## OFFICIAL LTR PINKTOBER CONVOY! 🌸
- Oficiální konvoj pro podporu léčby a prevence rakoviny prsu - Pinktober.
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/IaCWTde.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is reccomended for flowers & medical equipment or vaccines.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:30** - Meet at the parking slots in TruckersMP HQ.
*  **19:00**  - Departure from TruckersMP large parking.
*  **19:20**  - Passage trough the city of Prague.
*  **20:00**  - Passage around the city of Sttutgart.
*  **20:40** - Arrival of the convoy to the Geneva.
*  **20:45** - Final group photo and end of the convoy.



![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/DOffoNx.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. TruckersMP HQ, Cargotras - Geneva, SellPlan.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)

# 🎃👻 Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026 👻🎃

As darkness falls and ghostly figures begin to roam the roads, it's time for the **Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy**!

On October 31st, 2026, we invite you to join us for an unforgettable night filled with spooky vibes, impressive truck formations, and a strong sense of community. Together, we'll transform the roads of Euro Truck Simulator 2 into a haunting parade of lights, shadows, and Halloween spirit.

This convoy is all about bringing the community together. Whether you're part of a VTC, driving with friends, or joining on your own, everyone is welcome to take part in this spooky celebration.

### ***Important Information:***
* Registration is required.
* VTCs can book dedicated slots.
* Please provide an approximate participant count when booking a slot.
* Halloween-themed truck paint jobs and decorations are highly encouraged.

Let's make this Halloween night one to remember and show what the TruckersMP community is capable of when we come together.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026!

# 📋 **Event Rules**

By participating in this event, you agree to follow both the official TruckersMP Rules and the additional rules listed below.

## 🎃 **Halloween Convoy Rules**

1. 🚛 Participants must follow all instructions given by Event Staff, Convoy Control, and TruckersMP Staff at all times.

2. ⏰ Please arrive on time. Late arrivals may lose their assigned slot or be redirected to the public parking area.

3. 🚫 Overtaking during the convoy is strictly prohibited unless instructed by Event Staff.

4. 📏 Maintain a safe and consistent distance from the vehicle in front of you to avoid unnecessary braking and collisions.

5. 🚨 Excessive use of beacons, horns, lights, or other accessories that may distract participants should be avoided.

6. 🚚 Only approved VTCs may park in reserved slot areas. Public participants must use the designated public parking area.

7. 🎮 Reckless driving, ramming, blocking, racing, or any form of disruptive behaviour will not be tolerated.

8. 🔄 Participants must remain on the designated convoy route unless instructed otherwise by Event Staff.

9. 💬 Respect all participants regardless of VTC affiliation, language, or experience level.

10. 🎃 Halloween-themed paint jobs and decorations are encouraged, but they must remain compliant with TruckersMP rules.

11. 📸 Event Media and Staff vehicles may temporarily move around the convoy to capture screenshots and videos. Please allow them to perform their duties safely.

12. ⚠️ Any participant causing repeated disruptions may be removed from the event at the discretion of **Event Management (S_N_Sturmy), Event Staff and TruckersMP Staff**.

👻 Most importantly: Have fun, respect others, and enjoy a spooky night with the community!

## Rules for Participants
* The Event Staff are recognized as; “Need | CC, GM, Staff or Similar."
* Impersonating Event Staff using the tags mentioned above is forbidden.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers, and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Cars and Bus are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Overtaking is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants should park at their designated slots. You must park in the 'Public Parking' area if you don't have a designated slot.
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one-by-one) manner.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

## Event Rules for Event Staff
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. Following the rule above.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.
